Space.Agency on Instagram: "On July 8, 2011, Space Shuttle Atlantis launched for the final time on mission STS-135. This video shows the shuttle’s liftoff alongside footage of the crew inside the cabin, with real mission audio during ascent. Edited by Ivan Myles, the video combines NASA broadcast and onboard recordings to document the closing chapter of the Space Shuttle Program.
#STS135 #Atlantis #SpaceShuttle #NASA #SpaceHistory #RocketLaunch #HumanSpaceflight #SpaceExploration #ShuttleProgram #AtlantisLaunch"
content.text: I sat in the bar at the end of Cocoa Beach pier and watched this launch, fabulous atmosphere as it came into view.I would have a non stop grin from ear to earThose two solid rocket boosters kicked up the ascent. The Apollo flights took off and it seemed like they were in slow motion. Just a thought.I’d love if people spammed @waycnfzd_1 comment cuz he on some crazy bsNever should have stopped itThe shuttle was a cheap trashy design that flew only 25 percent of the flights that it was supposed to accomplish#BlindMind The Library Halls Are Full With Books Describing All Things That At Some Time Did Not Exist. But These Book Blind Us. They Contain Descriptions And Equations About Our Discoveries Of What Our Universe Brought Into Existence Before We Arrived. By Using Language And Mathematics That We Ourselves Take Credit For We Look On The Discovery As The Achievement And Not The Already Existing System. We Are Blind To There Being Only One Single System. This Is Consciousness. Everything That Can Be Observed. Everything that Can Not Be Directly Observed. Everything That Can Never Be Observed. It Existed Before We Existed. It Exists As We Exist. It Will Continue To Exist If We No Longer Exist. This Is Our Blindness. All Of What We Call Reality Is A Symmetry Of Consciousness. {C || E + mc2}. It Is Scaleless. It Is Timeless. It Is Omnipresent. It Is Boundless. It Is Resolute. Everything-Everywhere-All At Once.
